proverb.english: Do not reproach someone with what you gave them.
proverb.source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

content.meaning_en: A gift loses its worth when the giver reminds the receiver of it. Generosity should be given freely, without reproach.
content.meaning_ar: العطاء يفقد قيمته حين يذكّر المُعطي الآخذَ به. الكرم الحقّ يُعطى بلا مِنّة.
content.caption:
Ептар иумыхъуэныж
Yeptar iumıkhwenızh

Do not reproach someone with what you gave them. A gift mentioned again is a gift spoiled: true generosity gives freely and keeps silent.

لا تَمُنَّ بما أعطيت.
العطاء الذي يُذكَّر به صاحبه يفقد قيمته، والكرم الحقّ يُعطي بصمت.

Circassian proverb of the day.
